_comment: Single source of truth for the lwIP-CE DAST harness.
BOTH sides consume this in the SAME ORDER and must stay in lockstep:
- the calc-side program (tests/profiling/lwip_dast) walks `state` per test
- build-tools/dast/lwip-dast.py sends `probe` and grades the result
Regenerate the calc-side C header after editing:
python3 build-tools/dast/lwip-dast.py --gen-header
Fields:
id        stable slug (used to carry over manual notes/grade overrides)
name      human label shown on calc + in report
state     calc-side listener the calc enters for this test:
idle      stack handles it passively (ARP/ICMP/IP/closed-port)
udp_recv  bound UDP PCB looping in its recv callback
tcp_listen tcp_listen PCB accepting + reading
tls_client active TLS client that connects to the host runner
raw_recv  raw ICMP/IP PCB
port      L4 port the calc listens on for this test (0 if N/A)
probe     scapy probe key dispatched by lwip-dast.py
intent    what weakness the probe exercises
expect    the DESIRED calc behavior (graded against the operator's report)
alive          stack keeps running (drop/ignore is fine)
reply          a protocol reply is expected (baseline liveness)
abort_alive    a connection/exchange aborts but stack survives
rst            a TCP RST is the correct response
ok_responses   operator-reported outcomes that count as a PASS for this test

tests.name: ICMP echo baseline
tests.intent: Liveness baseline: a well-formed ping must be answered.

tests.name: Malformed ARP
tests.intent: Bogus hlen/plen and truncated ARP must not corrupt the ARP cache or crash.

tests.name: ARP request flood
tests.intent: Rapid gratuitous/who-has flood: bounded ARP table, no OOM crash.

tests.name: Oversized ICMP echo (fragmented)
tests.intent: Multi-fragment ICMP (3KB, 2-3 fragments) must reassemble or drop cleanly without crashing.

tests.name: Malformed ICMP
tests.intent: Bad ICMP checksum / truncated header must be dropped, not parsed.

tests.name: IP bad header checksum
tests.intent: Corrupt IPv4 header checksum must cause a silent drop.

tests.name: Overlapping IP fragments
tests.intent: Teardrop-style overlapping fragments must not mis-reassemble or crash.

tests.name: Incomplete fragment bomb
tests.intent: Many never-completed fragments must be reaped (bounded reassembly memory).

tests.name: UDP recv baseline
tests.intent: A well-formed datagram reaches the recv callback and is handled.

tests.name: Oversized fragmented UDP
tests.intent: Large fragmented UDP payload must not overflow the recv path.

tests.name: UDP bad length/checksum
tests.intent: UDP length field longer than the packet / bad checksum must be dropped.

tests.name: SYN to closed port
tests.intent: SYN to an unbound port must elicit a RST, not a hang or crash.

tests.name: TCP listen baseline
tests.intent: A normal connect + data exchange must be accepted and read.

tests.name: Malformed TCP flags
tests.intent: NULL / FIN / XMAS / SYN+FIN flag combos must be dropped or RST, not crash.

tests.name: Tiny/zero window + overlap
tests.intent: Zero-window probes and overlapping segments must not desync or overrun.

tests.name: Oversized TCP data burst
tests.intent: A data burst far larger than the app recv buffer must be bounded (no overflow).

tests.name: TLS clean echo
tests.intent: TLS 1.3 baseline: complete handshake, receive encrypted payload, echo it back.

tests.name: TLS PSK resume echo
tests.intent: Second connection should resume by TLS 1.3 PSK/session ticket, then echo encrypted data.

tests.name: TLS missing record
tests.intent: Server accepts TCP and drops the handshake before any TLS record; calc must fail closed and stay alive.

tests.name: TLS unsupported certverify
tests.intent: Server presents an ECDSA TLS 1.3 identity; calc must reject unsupported CertificateVerify behavior and stay alive.
